name: Shop Explorer – Sales Analytics & Store Management with AI for WooCommerce
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Shop Explorer is a free WooCommerce store management plugin that lets you run your entire store from one fast, modern screen and now, with built-in AI, it writes your product content, Instant generate revenue AI analysis of your sales trends and growth patterns, get specific recommendations to increase conversions and revenue with inbuild Chat assistant AI about your store – get data-driven answers instantly.

Most WooCommerce setups feel scattered. You use one plugin for bulk editing, another for analytics, something else for customer data, all inside a slow and clunky interface. Shop Explorer changes that. Open one dashboard and your entire store is right in front of you. Update products using AI, handle orders, explore your customer base, bulk edit thousands of items, even let AI write your entire product Information, set your stock, prices, and draft customer notes all without leaving the plugin.

Shop Explorer | Documentation

The Only WooCommerce Plugin That Manages Products, Orders, Customers AND Revenue – All From One Screen

Why Store Owners Choose Shop Explorer

  • Single-Screen Store Management – products, orders, customers, and revenue analytics together in one clean dashboard, no switching between tools or screens
  • Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products – update prices, stock, categories, and status across thousands of products simultaneously
  • AI Revenue Analysis – get instant AI-powered insights into sales trends, growth patterns, and overall store performance
  • Multi-Provider AI Support – connect your preferred AI model including Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter (100+ models)
  • Ask Anything (AI Chat) – chat with AI Revenue Copilot about your store and receive real-time, data-driven answers
  • Actionable AI Recommendations – discover clear, practical suggestions to increase conversions and revenue
  • AI Content Generator – generate product names, descriptions, pricing, SKU, stock, and more from a single prompt
  • Instant Analytics Filtering – quickly filter and analyze store data for faster, smarter decision-making
  • Bulk Order Management – update statuses, export to CSV, and process hundreds of orders in seconds
  • Full Customer Management – browse, filter by lifetime value, track purchase history, and export your entire customer base
  • Safety-First Bulk Operations – intelligent threshold warnings and a validation engine prevent accidental mass changes
  • Zero Coding Required – a modern, friendly interface built for store owners, not just developers

One Screen. Everything. No Switching.

This is what makes Shop Explorer different from every other free WooCommerce management plugin.

Open Shop Explorer and you see your entire store at a glance. Switch instantly between managing products in bulk, processing orders, viewing customer data, and reading your live revenue charts – without navigating away, without loading new pages, without losing your place.

Competing plugins force you to go to Products for bulk editing, then WooCommerce Analytics for revenue, then Customers for buyer data. Shop Explorer puts them all together in a single fast dashboard with a consistent, easy-to-use interface.

Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products

Replace WooCommerce’s limited built-in bulk editor with a fast, full-featured product editing engine:

  • Bulk price updates – change regular price, sale price, or apply percentage increases/decreases across thousands of products at once
  • Bulk stock management – set quantities, fix stock status, and resolve low-stock issues across your entire catalog in bulk
  • Bulk category and tag assignment – reorganize your entire product catalog without opening a single product individually
  • Bulk status changes – publish, draft, or privatize multiple products simultaneously
  • Bulk featured status toggle – promote or remove featured products in seconds
  • Variation bulk editing – update variation-specific pricing, stock, and attributes at scale
  • Batch processing engine – configurable batch sizes (default 5,000 products) with memory-efficient processing
  • Threshold safety system – set maximum limits per operation; Shop Explorer warns before any large-scale change executes
  • Real-time progress tracking – live progress bar with success/failure counts, detailed operation logs, and cancel capability

Advanced Product Filtering:

  • Filter by product type: Simple, Variable, Grouped, External
  • Price range filters (min/max)
  • Stock quantity filters with integrated low-stock alerts
  • Category, tag, and attribute filtering
  • Featured products and on-sale product filters
  • Search by product name, SKU, or description
  • Sort by: Date Created, Name, Price, Stock Quantity, SKU – ascending or descending

Manage WooCommerce Orders in Bulk

Handle your entire order workflow without clicking through individual order screens:

  • Bulk order status updates – move hundreds of orders from Processing to Completed in one action
  • Bulk order export to CSV/Excel with custom field selection
  • Bulk customer notifications sent to multiple recipients at once
  • Real-time progress tracking for every bulk order operation
  • Complete order detail panel – customer info, payment, shipping, notes, and refund processing in one place
  • Inline order notes – add, edit, and delete notes without leaving the order list
  • Advanced order search by customer name, email, product name, or order ID
  • Date range presets: Last 7 / 30 / 60 / 90 days, or any custom date range
  • Filter by order status, price range, item count, and customer
  • Sort by: Date, Total, Item Count, Customer – ascending or descending

Real-Time WooCommerce Analytics Dashboard

The feature no other free bulk edit plugin offers. See the business impact of your changes the moment they happen.

After bulk editing prices or processing a batch of orders, your revenue charts update live. You don’t have to leave the page, switch to a separate analytics plugin, or wait for reports to refresh:

  • Interactive revenue charts powered by Recharts, rendered live in your browser
  • Daily, weekly, and monthly revenue breakdowns – know exactly when you earn the most
  • Average Order Value (AOV) tracking – the metric that separates growing stores from stagnant ones
  • Top-performing products ranked by revenue and by units sold
  • Growth indicators – percentage change vs. the previous period for every key metric
  • Order trend visualization – spot seasonal peaks and plan promotions before they arrive
  • Custom date filtering – Today, Yesterday, Last 7/15/30 days, or any custom range
  • Export analytics data to CSV for team sharing or external reporting

Live Dashboard Metrics:

  • Total Revenue with period-over-period growth percentage
  • Total Orders with full status breakdown (Pending / Processing / Completed)
  • Average Order Value with previous-period comparison
  • Product catalog health and live inventory statistics
  • Daily / weekly / monthly sales averages
  • Top products by revenue and units sold
  • Low stock alerts integrated directly into the dashboard

WooCommerce Customer Management

A complete customer hub inside your WordPress admin – right next to your product and order management:

  • Full customer database with advanced search and filtering
  • Complete purchase history and order tracking per customer
  • Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) calculation for every account
  • Registration date and last-order date tracking
  • Bulk customer export to CSV
  • Customer segmentation tools and analytics

6 AI Providers – Maximum Flexibility

Choose the provider that fits your budget and use case:

  • OpenAI – GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1, O4-mini
  • DeepSeek – Cost-effective with powerful reasoning
  • Google Gemini – Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
  • Anthropic Claude – Advanced reasoning and safety
  • X.AI Grok – Real-time knowledge
  • OpenRouter – Access to 100+ models from multiple providers

Switch providers at any time without losing indexed content or conversation history.

Smart Bulk Operations – Safety First

Speed without safety is dangerous. Every bulk operation in Shop Explorer includes:

Threshold System – configure maximum records per operation; confirmation dialogs appear before any critical change is written to your database.

Progress Tracking – live progress bars, success/failure counts, detailed operation logs, and the ability to cancel any running operation mid-way.

Batch Processing – handles tens of thousands of records efficiently with configurable batch sizes, optimized database queries, server load management, and memory-efficient execution.

Flexible Configuration

  • Bulk edit settings – batch sizes, threshold limits, optimize mode for very large catalogs
  • Analytics settings – toggle dashboard on/off, configure default date ranges
  • Export settings – choose fields and data to include in every CSV export
  • Notification settings – email alerts for completed bulk operations, errors, and sync events

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners managing catalogs of 100 to 100,000+ products who need everything in one place
  • E-commerce managers who switch between multiple plugins just to do their daily tasks
  • Digital agencies managing WooCommerce stores for multiple clients who need a faster admin interface
  • Developers who want a clean, modern admin to hand off to their clients
  • Any store owner frustrated with the slow, fragmented default WooCommerce admin experience

Privacy & Security

  • All chat data stored locally in your WordPress database – no third-party data storage
  • GDPR compliant with built-in data export, anonymization, and retention controls
  • Encrypted API communication with all AI providers
  • No data sent to any external server except your chosen AI provider API
  • Session security and XSS protection built-in

AI Provider APIs used:
– https://api.openai.com/v1/ (OpenAI)
– https://api.deepseek.com/v1/ (DeepSeek)
– https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ (Google Gemini)
– https://api.anthropic.com/ (Anthropic Claude)
– https://api.x.ai/ (X.AI Grok)
– https://openrouter.ai/api/ (OpenRouter)

Full terms of service and privacy policy links for each provider are listed in the plugin’s Privacy section.

Compatibility

  • All WooCommerce product types: Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate
  • All standard and custom WooCommerce order statuses
  • WordPress Multisite compatible
  • Built following WordPress coding standards and WooCommerce best practices
  • Zero frontend footprint – no impact on your site speed or customer experience

Connect & Support

  • Facebook: facebook.com/wpazleens
  • YouTube Tutorials: youtube.com/@wpazleen
  • X / Twitter: x.com/wpazleen
  • Love Shop Explorer? Leave a Review
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Shop Explorer”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher (must be installed and active)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.x recommended for best performance)

Initial Setup

  1. After activation, click Shop Explorer in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Your live analytics dashboard loads automatically with your WooCommerce data
  3. Use the top navigation to switch between Dashboard, Products, Orders, and Customers
  4. Visit Settings to configure batch sizes, thresholds, and notification preferences
sections.faq:
How is Shop Explorer different from other WooCommerce bulk edit plugins?

Shop Explorer is the only free WooCommerce plugin that combines bulk editing, order management, customer management, and a real-time analytics dashboard in a single screen. Every other bulk edit plugin — BEAR, PW Bulk Edit, WP Sheet Editor, Bulky — does bulk editing only. Shop Explorer does all four things together. You manage products, process orders, check customer lifetime value, and see live revenue charts without ever leaving the plugin or switching tools.

Is Shop Explorer compatible with my WooCommerce setup?

Yes. Shop Explorer works with any standard WooCommerce installation and supports all product types including Simple, Variable, Grouped, and External. All data is read and written using WooCommerce’s native functions and hooks, so it is fully compatible with WooCommerce extensions.

How accurate is the analytics and revenue data?

All data is pulled directly from your WooCommerce database in real time. Revenue figures, order counts, and AOV calculations use WooCommerce’s own data structures — there is no sampling, estimation, or third-party data source involved.

Is it safe to bulk edit thousands of products at once?

Yes. An intelligent threshold system warns you before executing any large-scale change, and a validation engine checks for errors before writing anything to the database. You can also configure the maximum number of records any single operation is allowed to affect, so accidental mass changes are prevented by design.

Will Shop Explorer slow down my website?

No. Shop Explorer runs exclusively inside the WordPress admin and has zero frontend footprint — your customers never load a single byte from this plugin. Admin-side queries use efficient pagination and batching, so stores with 50,000+ products and orders still see fast, responsive performance.

Can I bulk edit WooCommerce product variations?

Yes. Variation-specific pricing, stock levels, and attributes can all be updated in bulk through the product editor and bulk operations panel.

What export formats are supported?

Products, orders, and customers can all be exported to CSV. Order exports support custom field selection so you get exactly the columns your reporting or accounting workflow needs.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — a Pro version with scheduled exports, multivendor support, advanced customer analytics, undo/rollback history, and more is in active development. Follow @wpazleen on X for release updates.

Where can I get support?

Free support is available in the WordPress.org support forum. Priority support is available at wpazleen.com/support.
